annotations.title: Crypto OHLCV: candles for any coin

description: Crypto OHLCV candles for any coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE…): open, high, low, close and volume per bar from Hyperliquid perpetuals, on intervals from 1 minute to 1 week, up to 500 bars, newest last. Without a coin the answer is for BTC. Use to chart a price, compute indicators, backtest a rule or give a trading agent recent price history. Example: coin=BTC. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
